x: John Mitchell became the first junior Belgrave member to ever compete for the AAA on the field,finishing 2nd in the Long Jump to P.Reed (22'9¾" [?]) with 22'3½", and Dave Rees placed 4th in the Pole Vault for London University.
Alan Lerwill did, however, compete in the final and managed to finish 7th but more significantly 3rd Briton behind Lynn Davies and Peter Reed.
